audit_items.proof_trace: The `already_consented` URL parameter is read in ConsentPage (page.tsx:L24) and used solely to render a UI hint message (L68-72); it does not auto-approve or skip the consent form. `handleConsent` (actions.ts:L17-23) never reads `already_consented` from formData — it always unconditionally calls `create_user_consent` and `create_authorization_code` RPCs (L67-91) after re-authenticating the user server-side, regardless of any URL parameters.
